chars.HUSBAND: HUSBAND: a Moroccan man of 32 with short black hair and a trimmed beard, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie and dark blue jeans
chars.WIFE: WIFE: a young Moroccan woman with long dark wavy hair tied in a low ponytail, wearing a lilac satin blouse and wide cream trousers, small gold hoop earrings

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated illustration, modern Casablanca apartment living room at night. WIFE sits on a beige sofa with arms crossed and chin raised, looking down her nose with a smug, innocent expression; HUSBAND stands in front of her, jaw clenched, holding his smartphone at his side. Both faces visible, framed head to waist in the centre.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated illustration, same living room at night. HUSBAND explodes in anger, leaning forward and holding his phone up toward WIFE's face, mouth open shouting; WIFE startled, leaning back on the sofa. Faces visible, central composition.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated illustration, living room at night. WIFE stands up, shrugging with open palms and a fake confused look, pretending she has no idea what he means. Head-to-waist, face visible, centred, calm background.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated illustration, living room at night. HUSBAND scrolls his phone and reads the messages out loud with a cold sarcastic face; WIFE beside him freezes, eyes widening. The phone screen faces away from the viewer. Both faces visible, central.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated illustration, close medium shot of WIFE in the living room at night: her smug expression collapses, eyes wide and filling with tears, hand rising to her mouth. Face visible, centred in the upper middle of the frame.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated illustration, living room at night. WIFE crying, reaching her hands toward HUSBAND pleading; HUSBAND turns half away from her, refusing to look. Both faces visible, central composition.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated illustration, HUSBAND alone by the apartment window at night with Casablanca city lights outside, fists clenched, eyes shut, trying to control his rage. Head-to-waist, face visible, centred.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated illustration, living room at night. HUSBAND points firmly at WIFE with a serious, decided face announcing his decision; WIFE sits on the sofa arm, shocked, tears on her cheeks. Faces visible, central.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated illustration, apartment hallway at night near the front door. HUSBAND stands with his hand on the door handle, hesitating with a torn, conflicted face, looking back at WIFE who sits on the floor of the hallway crying softly. Faces visible, central.
